mentions.name: Stillmark
mentions.description: A small experimental web app where users engage in a symbolic ritual to reflect on their digital habits. Inspired by Eastern philosophy, it aims to help people think about their time and intentions, with no ads and no tracking.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently built a small experimental web app where users engage in a symbolic ritual to reflect on their digital habits. It's inspired by Eastern philosophy and aims to help people think about their time and intentions—no ads, no tracking, just reflection.

evidence.value: I recently built a small experimental web app where users engage in a symbolic ritual to reflect on their digital habits. It's inspired by Eastern philosophy and aims to help people think about their time and intentions—no ads, no tracking, just reflection.
